cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, random, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from perf import make_topology, make_plan
rng = random.Random(9)
topology = make_topology(rng, nodes=40, links=60, externals=6)
externals = [n["id"] for n in topology["nodes"][:6]]
plan = make_plan(topology, externals)
names = {n["id"]: n["name"] for n in topology["nodes"]}
counters = {}
for link in topology["links"]:
    a, b = link["source"], link["target"]
    counters["low_%s_egress_to_%s" % (names[a], names[b])] = {"perturbed": 5, "ground_truth": 9}
    counters["low_%s_ingress_from_%s" % (names[b], names[a])] = {"perturbed": 5}
for e in externals:
    counters["low_%s_origination" % names[e]] = {"perturbed": 5}
    counters["low_%s_termination" % names[e]] = {"perturbed": 5}
request = {"streams": [{"topology": topology,
                        "settings": {"trials": 7, "epsilon": 30000, "seed": 3, "cutoff": [1, 2],
                                     "bias": 100, "tau": 5000, "gamma": [3, 4], "cache_slots": 3},
                        "events": [
                            {"op": "patch", "demands": [[a, b, 5] for a in externals for b in externals if a != b],
                             "counters": counters},
                            {"op": "routes", "label": "x", "paths": plan},
                            {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
                            {"op": "validate", "id": "a"},
                            {"op": "repair", "id": "b"},
                            {"op": "validate", "id": "b"}]}]}
data = json.dumps(request).encode()
outs = []
for seed in ['0', '1', '999']:
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONHASHSEED=seed)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data,
                       capture_output=True, env=env)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    outs.append(p.stdout)
print("deterministic:", len(set(outs)) == 1)
out = json.loads(outs[0].decode())
ev = out["streams"][0]["events"]
print("cache hits:", [e.get("cache_hit") for e in ev if e.get("op") == "repair"])
for e in ev:
    if e.get("op") == "validate":
        print("validate:", e["checked"], e["passed"], e["consistent"], e["failed"][:4])
print("sample links:", ev[2]["links"][:4])
PYEOF
